text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Royce and Royce...

Looking in the direction Royce and Royce pointed,
there was a claw crane machine filled with plushies
themed after various Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
There are some new Paka Puchi items in here.
Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: If we're talking like that, then everything!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
As someone aiming to be everyone's darling,
Paka Petit is an absolute must-have item.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Liking cute things" is the classic, right?
And the classic never fails.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course, having any of them is fine,
but taking relationships and team chemistry into account
will leave an even better impression.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: From that perspective as well, this lineup is definitely not something you want to miss!
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll do my best to get it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh, is it really okay for me to ask?
choice_data_list: You need it for your self-producing, right?
That's necessary for your self-producing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, thank you.
In that case, at least let me cheer you on!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
